Preview: 750 ml, 24-hour cold hold. Grab it before Sunday.
Body: You've got a trip coming up. The Summit Bottle is built for the kind of day where you fill up once at the trailhead and don't think about water again.

750 ml capacity. Double-wall stainless steel that keeps drinks cold for 24 hours and hot for 12. No fuss, no fiddling — just water that's still cold when you hit the ridge.

A note on fit: the Summit is sized for day trips and shoulder-season hiking. It's not designed for multi-day backcountry routes where weight is everything — you'll want something lighter for that.

This weekend, NB-BTL-03 is 40% off. Offer ends Sunday.
